leadText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the Pokémon movies in . DVD releases are for , releases are for (although they may be playable in other regions), and all releases are .

Lucario and the Mystery of Mew and Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea have not been released on home video in the United Kingdom.
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the Pokémon movies in . DVD releases are for , releases are for (although they may be playable in other regions), and all releases are .

Lucario and the Mystery of Mew and Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea have not been released on home video in the United Kingdom.

==Single movie releases==
===Mewtwo Strikes Back===
====Original release====
Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back was released on VHS and DVD in the United Kingdom by on October 23, 2000. The catalogue numbers for the VHS and DVD respectively are V018020 and S018020. These releases use a 4:3 .

The Pikachu short Pikachu's Vacation is also included before the film, and the promotional card was included in early releases.

The DVD has English, French, Italian, Dutch, and Portuguese audio; with optional English, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, English for the hearing impaired, and Italian for the hearing impaired closed captions. The DVD was first released in snapper case packaging before being released in standard DVD packaging. It also includes the following extras:
Commentary audio track by Director Michael Haigney and Producer Norman J. Grossfeld
The Story of Mewtwo's Origin (first two minutes of The Uncut Story of Mewtwo's Origin)
Music video for 's " " (the movie's ending theme)
Theatrical trailer of the movie
Preview of The Power of One
"Ash's Journey"
DVD-ROM features
Pokemon fun facts
History of the animated series
History of the video games
Pokémon Web World
Nintendo game guides
special events page
Pokémon webcards
Poké-patterns
Pokémon posters

The VHS release includes The Story of Mewtwo's Origin (the first two minutes of The Uncut Story of Mewtwo's Origin) added to the beginning of the movie and the preview for The Power of One.

 

====Re-release====
Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back was re-released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on October 2, 2017 by . This is a single-disc re-release of the disc featured in the Pokémon Movie Collection.

The DVD was also included in early copies of Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!.

 

===The Power of One===
====Original release====
 
Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One was released in the United Kingdom by . It was released on VHS on March 19, 2001, with the catalogue number S018620, and on DVD on May 14, 2001 with the catalogue number D018620. The DVD release uses a 1.85:1 .

The Pikachu short Pikachu's Rescue Adventure is included before the film, and the promotional card was included in early releases.

The DVD is a double-sided disc that has English, French, and Dutch audio on Side A and English, German, and Italian audio on Side B; with optional English, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Arabic, English for the hearing impaired, German for the hearing impaired, and Italian for the hearing impaired closed captioning. The DVD was first released in snapper case packaging before being released in standard DVD packaging. It also includes the following extras:
Musical performances from the Pokémon the Movie 2000 soundtrack
"They Don't Understand" by 
"Story Of" and performance by Alysha Antonino
"Pokémon World" by featuring 
Making of the soundtrack
Theatrical trailer of the movie
Theatrical trailer of Spell of the Unown: Entei

The VHS release has the short Polka-Dot Puss play before The Video Standards Council classification bumper, and includes the preview for Spell of the Unown: Entei. 

The movie was re-released in 2007 for ' "Worth it!" budget range.

 

====Re-release====
Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One was re-released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on October 2, 2017 by . This is a single-disc re-release of the disc featured in the Pokémon Movie Collection.

 

===Spell of the Unown: Entei===
====Original release====
 
Pokémon 3: The Movie - Spell of the Unown: Entei was released on VHS and DVD in the United Kingdom by on October 6, 2001. The catalogue numbers for the VHS and DVD respectively are S021101 and D021251. The DVD release uses a 1.85:1 .

The Pikachu short Pikachu & Pichu is included before the film, and although no bonuses were added in early releases, some retailers offered a promotion where customers would obtain the promotional card and a VHS with the purchase of the VHS or DVD.

The DVD is a double-sided disc that has English, French, and Dutch audio on Side A and Italian, Greek, and Hebew audio on Side B; with optional English, Dutch, French, Greek, Italian, Hebrew, English for the hearing impaired, and Italian for the hearing impaired closed captioning. The DVD was first released in snapper case packaging before being released in standard DVD packaging. It also includes the following extras:
Pokérap GS (Johto Pokérap)
Making of "To Know the Unknown"
What the Filmmakers Say (Commentary audio track)
Theatrical trailer of the movie
Little Known Unown Facts!

 

====Re-release====
Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One was re-released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on October 2, 2017 by . This is a single-disc re-release of the disc featured in the Pokémon Movie Collection.

 

===Celebi: The Voice of the Forest===
====Original release====
 
Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest was released on VHS and DVD in the United Kingdom by and on October 20, 2003. The catalogue numbers for the VHS and DVD respectively are D611536 and D888868. The DVD release uses a 1.85:1 .

The DVD has English and Spanish audio; with optional English, English for the hearing impaired, and Spanish closed captioning. The DVD release includes the following extras:
Audio commentary by the actors and producers
Multi-angle animation progression on four scenes
A trivia game
English theatrical trailer
Japanese theatrical trailer and Pikachu's PikaBoo trailer
Japanese Theatrical trailer of Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias and Camp Pikachu

None of the Japanese trailers have any subtitles.

 

====Re-release====
Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest was re-released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on May 9, 2011 by , with the catalogue number MIROPD2170. The packaging is identical to that of the Buena Vista release, but replaces all mentions of them with StudioCanal branding. The content on the disc is the same as the Buena Vista version, keeping all logos and graphics intact.

Within an unknown timeframe, fhe film was re-released again by under the same catalogue number of MIROPD2170. This release is the same as the StudioCanal version but features different logos and copyright information on the back cover. The disc retains StudioCanal branding.

The movie was re-released again on DVD in the United Kingdom on August 16, 2021 by , following ViacomCBS's co-purchase of Miramax.

 

===Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias===
====Original release====
 
Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by and on June 6, 2005. The catalogue number for the DVD is BUA0000501. The DVD release uses a 1.85:1 , but in reality only the menus and trailers are shown in this ratio. The movie and special features show in a 4:3 , while the Camp Pikachu short shows in a Pillarbox format.

The DVD has English, French, and Spanish audio; with optional English, English for the hearing impaired, French, and Spanish closed captioning. The DVD release includes the following extras:
Location scouting in Venice
An animation stages feature (Water Chariot Race, Race Spectators, Crowd on a Bridge, Latias, Defense Mechanism of Alltomare, Wave)
The Characters of "Pokémon Heroes"
The Pikachu short Camp Pikachu
Pokémon Heroes trivia game

The movie also has a trailer for and Pokémon 4Ever which play before the main menu.

 

====Re-release====
Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias was re-released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom on May 9, 2011 by , with the catalogue number MIROPD2165. The packaging is identical to that of the Buena Vista release, but replaces all mentions of them with StudioCanal branding. The content on the disc is the same as the Buena Vista version, keeping all logos and graphics intact.

The DVD was re-released by StudioCanal in 2016 under the slightly altered catalogue number of MIROPD2165-R2. This version uses a newer print of the film that removes some of the blue tinting, is shown in a 1.85:1 , replaces logos, and does not contain any special features or the Pikachu short.

The movie was re-released again on DVD in the United Kingdom on August 16, 2021 by , following ViacomCBS's co-purchase of Miramax.

 

===Jirachi: Wish Maker===
Jirachi: Wish Maker was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on October 23, 2006 with the catalogue number PHE9081. This release uses a 1.85:1 , but does not include closed captioning despite the packaging saying it does. It also includes the following extras:
Character Gallery
Photo Gallery

 

===Destiny Deoxys===
Destiny Deoxys was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by and on April 2, 2012. The catalogue number is MIROPD2186. This release uses a 1.85:1 .

The movie was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on August 16, 2021 by , following ViacomCBS's co-purchase of Miramax.

 
 

===The Rise of Darkrai===
The Rise of Darkrai was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on September 29, 2008 with the catalogue number PM7510. This release uses a . The promotional card was included in early releases of the DVD.

It was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 15, 2019 by . This re-release uses the DVD master used in Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl.

 

===Giratina and the Sky Warrior===
Giratina and the Sky Warrior was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on November 28, 2011 with the catalogue number 8287463. This release uses a 1.85:1 . It has English and Norwegian audio, but does not have closed captioning.

It was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 15, 2019 by . This re-release uses the DVD master used in Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl. This release uses a .

 

===Arceus and the Jewel of Life===
Arceus and the Jewel of Life was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on November 28, 2011 with the catalogue number 8287464. This release uses a 1.85:1 . It has English, Norwegian, and Danish audio, but does not have closed captioning.

It was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 15, 2019 by . This re-release uses the DVD master used in Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl. This release uses a .

 

===Zoroark: Master of Illusions===
Zoroark: Master of Illusions was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on August 29, 2011 with the catalogue number 8284462. This release uses a 1.85:1 . The promotional card was included in early releases of the DVD.

It was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 15, 2019 by . This re-release uses the DVD master used in Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl. This release uses a .

 

===White—Victini and Zekrom and Black—Victini and Reshiram===
White—Victini and Zekrom and Black—Victini and Reshiram was first released on a multi-movie set by and was later re-issued on a single disc on ’s Pokémon Movie Collection: Black and White.

The single-disc version seen in the boxset was re-released on September 2, 2019, once again by Manga Entertainment. This release uses a .

===Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice===
Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on September 30, 2013 with the catalogue number 8296140. This release uses a . It has English and Dutch audio, but does not have closed captioning. The promotional card was included in early releases of the DVD.

It was re-released on DVD in the United Kingdom on September 2, 2019 by . This re-release uses the DVD master used in Pokémon Movie Collection: Black and White.

 

===Genesect and The Legend Awakened===
Genesect and The Legend Awakened was first released on DVD in the UK on the Pokémon Black and White Movie Collection boxset by .

Manga Entertainment released the movie separately for the first time in the UK on September 2, 2019. This release uses a .

===Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction===
Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction was first released on DVD in the UK on the Pokémon XY Movie Collection boxset by .

Manga Entertainment released the movie separately for the first time in the UK on September 2, 2019. This release uses a .

===Hoopa and the Clash of Ages===
 
Hoopa and the Clash of Ages was released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom by on October 24, 2016. This release uses a . The DVD's product number is MANG5805.

 

===Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel===
 
Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel was released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom by on May 15, 2017. This release uses a .

 

===Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!===
 
Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You! was released in the United Kingdom by on DVD on February 12, 2018 and was released on Blu-ray in a Steelbook case on April 30, 2018. Both releases use a . The Steelbook’s catalogue number is MANB8853.

Two versions of the DVD release were available; one included a bonus disc featuring Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back, while the other did not. The Blu-Ray Steelbook version is no longer in print.

 

===Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us===
 
Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us was released in the United Kingdom by on DVD and Blu-Ray on February 18, 2019. Both versions use a 16:9 aspect ratio. The Blu-Ray’s catalogue number is MANB6725.

The Blu-Ray version is a Collector's Edition, including a poster and 4 art cards, and was released in a cardboard sleeve.

==Multi-movie releases==
===Pokémon 4Ever & Pokémon Heroes===
The Pokémon 4Ever & Pokémon Heroes Blu-ray was distributed by in the United Kingdom. It was released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 2, 2012 with the catalogue number MIROPBD2425. It contains a single disc with both movies: Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest and Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias. This release uses a 1.85:1 . It does not include any special features, despite the packaging claiming to contain them.

 

===Pokémon the Movie: 2 Movie Pack===
The Pokémon the Movie: Black—Victini and Reshiram / White—Victini and Zekrom 2 Movie Pack is a multi-movie DVD set released in the United Kingdom by . It was released in the United Kingdom on April 9, 2012 with the catalogue number 8288750. It contains two discs, one with Black—Victini and Reshiram and the other with White—Victini and Zekrom. This set uses a , but does not include closed captioning. The promotional card was included in early releases of the DVD.

It was released both as a box set (containing individual DVD cases for each movie), as well as a single DVD case containing two discs.

 

===Pokémon Triple Movie Collection===
 
The Pokémon Triple Movie Collection DVD set was distributed by in the United Kingdom. It was released on DVD in the United Kingdom on August 29, 2016 with the catalogue number MIROPD3086. It contains three discs, with one movie on each. It includes Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest, Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias, and Destiny Deoxys. 

The collection was re-released on DVD under the name "Pokémon 3 Film Collection" in the United Kingdom in 2021 by , following ViacomCBS's co-purchase of Miramax.

 

===Pokémon Movie Collection===
 
The Pokémon Movie Collection is a multi-movie set released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom by . It was released on Blu-ray in a Collector's Edition Steelbook and on DVD in the United Kingdom on November 14, 2016. It was released on Blu-ray in standard case in the United Kingdom on April 3, 2017. It contains three discs, with one movie on each. It includes Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back, Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One, and Pokémon 3: The Movie - Spell of the Unown: Entei. This set uses a . The Steelbook’s catalog number is MANB8790.

It does not include any special features or Pikachu shorts.

 

===Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond & Pearl===
Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl is a multi-movie set released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on May 21, 2018 with the catalogue number MANG5889. It contains four discs, with one movie on each. It includes The Rise of Darkrai, Giratina and the Sky Warrior, Arceus and the Jewel of Life and Zoroark – Master of Illusions. All the movies are shown in a .

 

===Pokémon Movie Collection: Black & White===
Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl is a multi-movie set that was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on July 9, 2018 (originally scheduled to be released on July 23, 2018) with the catalog number MANG5894. It contains three discs, including both Victini and Reshiram and Victini and Zekrom on a single disc, Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice and Genesect and the Legend Awakened. This is the very first UK DVD release for the latter. All the movies are shown in a .

===Pokémon Movie Collection: XY===
Pokémon Movie Collection: XY is a multi-movie set that was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on October 22, 2018 with the catalogue number MANG5898. It contains three discs, each containing a single movie. It features Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction, Hoopa and the Clash of Ages and Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel. This is the very first UK DVD release for the former, while the other two are re-issues of their 2016 and 2017 releases respectively. All the movies are shown in a .

sections.text: Hoopa and the Clash of Ages was released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom by on October 24, 2016. This release uses a . The DVD's product number is MANG5805.

sections.heading: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel
sections.text: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel was released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom by on May 15, 2017. This release uses a .

sections.heading: Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!
sections.text:
Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You! was released in the United Kingdom by on DVD on February 12, 2018 and was released on Blu-ray in a Steelbook case on April 30, 2018. Both releases use a . The Steelbook’s catalogue number is MANB8853.

Two versions of the DVD release were available; one included a bonus disc featuring Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back, while the other did not. The Blu-Ray Steelbook version is no longer in print.

sections.heading: Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us
sections.text:
Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us was released in the United Kingdom by on DVD and Blu-Ray on February 18, 2019. Both versions use a 16:9 aspect ratio. The Blu-Ray’s catalogue number is MANB6725.

The Blu-Ray version is a Collector's Edition, including a poster and 4 art cards, and was released in a cardboard sleeve.

sections.heading: Pokémon 4Ever & Pokémon Heroes
sections.text: The Pokémon 4Ever & Pokémon Heroes Blu-ray was distributed by in the United Kingdom. It was released on DVD in the United Kingdom on April 2, 2012 with the catalogue number MIROPBD2425. It contains a single disc with both movies: Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest and Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias. This release uses a 1.85:1 . It does not include any special features, despite the packaging claiming to contain them.

sections.heading: Pokémon the Movie: 2 Movie Pack
sections.text:
The Pokémon the Movie: Black—Victini and Reshiram / White—Victini and Zekrom 2 Movie Pack is a multi-movie DVD set released in the United Kingdom by . It was released in the United Kingdom on April 9, 2012 with the catalogue number 8288750. It contains two discs, one with Black—Victini and Reshiram and the other with White—Victini and Zekrom. This set uses a , but does not include closed captioning. The promotional card was included in early releases of the DVD.

It was released both as a box set (containing individual DVD cases for each movie), as well as a single DVD case containing two discs.

sections.heading: Pokémon Triple Movie Collection
sections.text:
The Pokémon Triple Movie Collection DVD set was distributed by in the United Kingdom. It was released on DVD in the United Kingdom on August 29, 2016 with the catalogue number MIROPD3086. It contains three discs, with one movie on each. It includes Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest, Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias, and Destiny Deoxys. 

The collection was re-released on DVD under the name "Pokémon 3 Film Collection" in the United Kingdom in 2021 by , following ViacomCBS's co-purchase of Miramax.

sections.heading: Pokémon Movie Collection
sections.text:
The Pokémon Movie Collection is a multi-movie set released on DVD and Blu-ray in the United Kingdom by . It was released on Blu-ray in a Collector's Edition Steelbook and on DVD in the United Kingdom on November 14, 2016. It was released on Blu-ray in standard case in the United Kingdom on April 3, 2017. It contains three discs, with one movie on each. It includes Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back, Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One, and Pokémon 3: The Movie - Spell of the Unown: Entei. This set uses a . The Steelbook’s catalog number is MANB8790.

It does not include any special features or Pikachu shorts.

sections.heading: Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond & Pearl
sections.text: Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl is a multi-movie set released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on May 21, 2018 with the catalogue number MANG5889. It contains four discs, with one movie on each. It includes The Rise of Darkrai, Giratina and the Sky Warrior, Arceus and the Jewel of Life and Zoroark – Master of Illusions. All the movies are shown in a .

sections.heading: Pokémon Movie Collection: Black & White
sections.text: Pokémon Movie Collection: Diamond and Pearl is a multi-movie set that was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on July 9, 2018 (originally scheduled to be released on July 23, 2018) with the catalog number MANG5894. It contains three discs, including both Victini and Reshiram and Victini and Zekrom on a single disc, Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice and Genesect and the Legend Awakened. This is the very first UK DVD release for the latter. All the movies are shown in a .

sections.heading: Pokémon Movie Collection: XY
sections.text: Pokémon Movie Collection: XY is a multi-movie set that was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by on October 22, 2018 with the catalogue number MANG5898. It contains three discs, each containing a single movie. It features Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction, Hoopa and the Clash of Ages and Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel. This is the very first UK DVD release for the former, while the other two are re-issues of their 2016 and 2017 releases respectively. All the movies are shown in a .
